steps.text: The stories tell us that evil never triumphs over good.
Most of the time, I take this as a matter of course.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Do you really have to go?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I saw the news. Things are heating up between the mob and the police.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I saw blood. Lots of people bleeding...

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Don't worry, honey, things aren't that bad.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: It's just the media playing things up. 'If it bleeds, it leads,' you know. That's how they get paid.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Don't let them scare you.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: The man at the smoke shop says not so many nobles come by for liquor anymore. And Aunt Nina, who works at Lord Santelli's estate, came home. She says the Lord's entire staff is furloughed.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Don't you think... don't you think that means——

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Man
steps.text: ...Sorry. I shouldn't have raised my voice.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Loban, I'm just... I'm just so worried.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: I said not to worry. Don't be scared. I'm here. You can trust me. I will protect you.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: And it's not only me. I have the rest of the Guard garrison with me, and the Army is just outside the city too. There's nothing to be afraid of.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Loban...

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Relax, Darya. We swore to protect this city, and this home.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Let's not trouble your pretty little head. This winter will pass, and when the weather warms up, we'll go someplace nice. How does that sound?

steps.name: Man
steps.text: And don't tell Zoya. Let it be just the two of us, off on a romantic getaway. Alright?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: ...hehe.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: How are you still like this, even at your age?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: It's so cold. Where are we going to go for a romantic getaway when the snow melts and the roads turn to mud?

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Isn't that the perfect way to end the winter? When the time comes, we'll go dancing, you'll bring some mead from home, and I'll bake you cookies myself.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Oho, bold words. Do you still remember how? I think... we could. Just wait for Zoya to go back to school. When she's safely in her dormitory, we'll head off.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Sure! Now, how long until school starts? Could we move her in early?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Nonsense!

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Zoya? We were just talking about you. Come, your father's on the night shift. Say goodbye.
There were happy moments that at the time erupted suddenly with such potency, they brought an unparalleled sense of being.
Or maybe they felt very ordinary. Only in retrospect do I realize what the feeling was.
Everyday conversations for a monotonous life.
As if spring would come as usual. As if the snow would melt, the people would tie the hay into straw men, and trample about the mud amidst the aroma of pale mead.
The usual greetings: good morning, good evening, hello, goodbye.
Until that day——
Our city, before our very eyes, twisted, deformed, erupted.
Ahead left, clear.
Now.
No signal. Can't make contact.
Phew. I have their patrol routes figured out, so I should be fine here. Just need to get over the fence...
I'll make it this time!
(What? Someone's coming! This isn't on the patrol route... I have to hide.)

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: (Inaudible).

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: (Excited, but still inaudible).
(I should be okay hiding here for a while.)
(That sounded like those guys who call themselves 'Reunion.' And it was a bunch of them... The one on the left doesn't look the same as the ones I see on patrol.)
(What is going on? They come out of nowhere and lock us all up in the school. What do they even want?)
(They're coming this way!)

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: What is Mephisto thinking?

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Would he really volunteer to take over? He wants to deal with the students over there? Not sure I believe he's that kind-hearted.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: They rounded up most of the noble kids along with all the others at Peterheim. Why go that far?

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: That school is a ways away from the one they stationed us at. And if Mephisto is up to something, there's not much we can do...

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: *Sigh*, I hope he can stay focused on the big picture. We don't want him screwing around.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Who knows what goes on in that psychopathic little head of his? Maybe he does it on purpose!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: He's a freak! A monster!

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Hey, calm down. Don't forget, we're on the same team...

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: What do you mean calm down? Did you not see what he was doing with his Arts last time? That shit's straight-up evil!

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Lower your voice!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Does he even think we're on the same team? Bullshit!

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: I told you to quiet down! Don't spook the students!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Damn it!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Sorry. I let it get to me.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: I get it. I know how you feel. Who doesn't?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Honestly, I think about killing Mephisto sometimes. If it wasn't for the Captain, I'd go kill him right now!

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Don't talk like that. You think I don't want to kill him? You think the Captain doesn't?

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: But we can't. He's our people. And we don't kill our own people. That's at the core of our movement.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: But yeah, it's normal to be angry.... with what he did this time.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: We watched his men, running wild, tearing everything up. Are we thugs who break into houses, kill people, set fires?
(Who is Mephisto?)
(Are they talking about... killing people?!)
(Did I hear that right? They didn't do anything to the students. Why...?)

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Hah, well said. Are we not thugs then?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Maybe the Captain's troops aren't. But if you ask me, we're not exactly doing good for this city.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: How many blocks have we leveled? How many people have we dragged out of their homes and killed in the street? It's a mess out there. We all know.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: We have no choice. The people out there can't tell who belongs to whose squad. They don't care.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: As long as any of 'our people' are doing those things, then the people here will see us all as thugs.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Rolena, you're back. Are you ready for the handover?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: All ready.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Good. The Captain is on a tight schedule with this new job from the leadership. Your teams are doing final cleanup on the suppressed districts.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: And you'll want to keep an eye on the Sarkaz mercenaries.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Oh, and look after the students. The Captain is keeping them here. Don't hurt them, but don't let them escape either.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Understood. If the cubs behave, I'm happy to let things be, but what if they act out?

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Just try not to hurt them.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: But what if I have to? What if some of them can use Arts? If they fight back, we'll have to take action.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Rolena, I know what you mean. You've got fire in you. But don't get out of hand. This is an order from the Captain.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Keep your emotions under control. Don't let them overpower your judgment.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Hah. If it's from the Captain, I will abide.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: I hope so.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: We'll start the transfer in thirty minutes. Then this place is your responsibility... What exactly that means is up to you.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Up to me? Will you be able to sleep at night?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I said I'll abide, but I don't handle it all personally. Threats, intimidation, and terror make people behave. We'll do what it takes...

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Hey, I'm just kidding. Don't look at me like that. I know what I have to do.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Whew, you said all that way too easy.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Seriously, I don't care about the plan or whatever. Have you thought about where we're going to end up if this city goes down?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: We never had anywhere to go.

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: No. We can go anywhere. Someday, we'll be able to go anywhere we want.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: That'd be nice. You think that day will really come?
(What are they talking about? Who are they?)
(What's so funny? Those bastards. They come out of nowhere and occupy the city. They imprison us here, and for what?)
(And it looks like this goes way beyond the school...)
(Dammit, what's happening outside then?)
(I can't stay here anymore. I have to get back.)
(Mom, Dad...)
(They didn't see me. Now's my chance...!)

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Did you hear that...?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Hear what?

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Strange...

steps.name: Reunion Squad Leader
steps.text: Anyway, that's the deal. It's up to you now.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Go on already. Don't let us hold up your mission.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: He's gone.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Yeah. He has his job, now we have ours.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: What's ours? Didn't he just say your job is to watch those students and don't let them out?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Right. What's your point?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Don't be play dumb. You really didn't notice?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I thought I was the only one.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Looks like you've been doing well under the Captain. And that training sharpened you up good. Better than I expected.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Don't mince words.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Fine. I don't like to beat around the bush either.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Would you believe me if I said I let that schoolgirl get away on purpose?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: You really think I'm that stupid?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Turns out you're not.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Say, didn't I hear that you're from around here?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: What's it to you? I know you are too. I've seen you in the Old Quarter, Rolena the Tailor.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: But what does it matter? We're both Infected now.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: And we all know what we've done. So who cares where we're from?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: ...Do you know what would have happened to that girl if I just grabbed her?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I figure I'd have to break a leg or two to teach her to stay in her room. Would that have gone against orders? Would that have been a bridge too far?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Hah. You're a real hardass.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Or I could have just killed her. The Captain's team is gone anyway. Besides the guerillas, who's going to care if I kill a student or two?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: She could be an example to the other kids.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: You wouldn't do that. You wouldn't go against the Captain's orders.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: You're right.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: The group under the old man, Patriot, they've had a rough go of it too, huh? Those kids have made a lot of noise for them over the past week.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: If we don't do something, the students won't know fear, and we'll have the bolder ones looking to get out every other day.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: They don't know what it's like outside. They don't know how bad it's gotten.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: And aside from the few noble kids, what good are they to the movement?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: The Captain told us to keep the school under control. Was that just to protect the little cubs?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Why are we even talking about this?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Come on, didn't you just let that girl go? It's because you were afraid I'd catch her and do something to her, right?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Just come out with it.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I'm curious. Do you feel for the people here?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: No matter how they treated you before, how they treated your brothers, just because you were Infected... You don't hate them?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: No, I can tell from your tone. You do hate them.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Cut the crap! I just don't think a schoolgirl can cause that much trouble, even if she wanders around the campus.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I think you actually believe your own bullshit.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: What bullshit? Don't change the subject. You saw that girl too!

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: So, since you're such a ruthless killer, why didn't you drag her out and beat her to a pulp?

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I'm not like you.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Oh? Can't even own up to it——

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I'm not like you. I'm not you.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I didn't drag her out precisely because I know she's not just wandering around the school.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: It's clear as day. That girl's trying to escape.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Once she gets out of the campus and our 'controlled' area, she'll find a place that's not so peaceful.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...Wait.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Why the hell didn't you stop her?! If she gets out, she's gonna, she's gonna...

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Yep. She's walking into her own grave.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: Why should I stop her? Even if I caught her, I couldn't do anything. Captain's orders.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: So I let her go.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I told you, I'm not like you. You're still soft. Even now, you're worried about those kids.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: But me? I can't forget what me and my family suffered at the hands of this city.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I hate them all.

steps.name: Reunion Caster
steps.text: I hope that girl doesn't die too quickly. Haha! Open your eyes and take a good look at the suffering around you.
I've never seen this side of the city.
Houses destroyed, roads blocked, windows sealed up, broken bricks strewn across the street like so many toy blocks.
Smoke rises from the fires all around me, carrying sorrowful wails on the wind.
All while the armed men cheer, carving their symbols on every surface they can find. I hear their name. The murderers say it with pride.
They call themselves——Reunion.
...Agh, it hurts...
(It takes about two hours to get from school to the center city? Give or take?)
(I can't hear anything. That should be temporary. And I can't feel my left hand... looks like my little finger is broken too. Hrm...)
(There's a sharp pain in my abdomen. But it's no big deal yet.
(Don't panic, Zoya. You made it this far. Just keep carrying on like this. Don't rush it. Most important thing is to stay hidden from the bad guys...)
(Another explosion. I think it came from the park this time.)
(How many times is that now?!)
(What the hell happened...?! Where are the police? Where's the military? Why has nobody come to restore order yet?)
(Looks like I can't get through ahead. And those people fighting look like Reunion? Who's fighting against them...?)
Damn. I'm almost home. Why does it have to be now?!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Those bastards! They're monsters! Monsters!
(The crowd is out of control. More panicked than usual...)
Um, what's happening over——

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Get out of my way!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: What are you doing? Run already!

steps.name: Ursus Woman
steps.text: My baby! Where's my baby?!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: They're coming! Shit! Hurry!

steps.name: Ursus Child
steps.text: Wahhh, Mama... Mamaaa...
Look out!
(Agh, my wound. That hurt...)
Are you okay?

steps.name: Ursus Child
steps.text: Waaaahhh! Waahhhh! Let go! Let me go!
Hey, wait!

steps.name: Ursus Police
steps.text: Fall back!
(Finally, the police! Now we'll be okay.)

steps.name: Ursus Police
steps.text: There's a situation up ahead. This block is now on lockdown!

steps.name: Ursus Police
steps.text: Hey! Do you have a deathwish?! Turn back! There's Reunion that way!

steps.name: Ursus Police
steps.text: ...Hold on, aren't you Zoya? What are you doing here?!
Uncle Valery!
What in the world is going on? Who the hell are these Reunion people? And where is everyone?

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Let us through!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: You have to let us out! They're killing people! You're the police, you have to know what to do!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Don't panic! Calm down. We're going to——
Uncle Valery!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I'm okay...

steps.name: Ursus Police
steps.text: Don't push! Stop! I said calm the hell down!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: What are the cops good for?! You useless shits, go put a stop to those Infected!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: They're coming! They're going to kill us——
Hey! That's enough!

steps.name: Ursus Civilian
steps.text: Get out of my way! I don't wanna die...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Stop them!
How could they do...! Uncle Valery, are you okay?

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I'm fine. The people are all in a panic these days. We see this a lot. We're almost used to it.
But why...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Doesn't matter. I don't have much time to talk with you.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I have to stop these civilians. It's too dangerous up ahead. Those people out there are monsters. They're nothing like the normal Infected.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Anton, get your team over there!

steps.name: Ursus Police
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Anyway, what are you doing here, Zoya? And how did you get here?

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I heard their warlord say that students would be kept locked up in their schools.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: And yours is pretty far from here. How did... Never mind. Doesn't matter. You need to come with me. It's too dangerous here.
Wait, Uncle, you still didn't tell me what happened!
I came through the alleys, hiding from the bad men, and things just kept getting crazier the farther I went.
There were explosions everywhere. Buildings collapsed. So many injured people. I saw them setting fires. How could they do this?
My family... is Dad fighting Reunion too? Where is he? And where's Mom? I have to find——
Wh... why aren't you saying anything...?
Uncle Valery, are my parents...?

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: ...Your father is safe.
Really?!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: But——

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Your neighborhood was one of the first to be attacked.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Those Infected, the Reunion people, they devastated every district they entered. We had no choice but to prioritize evacuating civilians in high-risk areas.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Your father and I... we both agreed on this.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: We had to look at the situation and make appropriate judgments. It's our responsibility. There were trade-offs.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: ...By the time the rescue team reached your block, things were already beyond saving.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: It was a disaster. It's hard to imagine how anything like that happened.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Everything had been melted. Grass, bricks, steel beams, everything. Not even snow could touch the scorched earth.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I won't tell you your mother might have escaped. You're a smart kid. I can't lie to you.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I'm sorry. We were too late.
You're lying. You have to be... that's impossible.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Zoya!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Zoya... Listen to me. I'm telling the truth.
You can't be. Dad said...
He said he'd protect us.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: There's nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: I have the rest of the Guard garrison with me, and the Army is just outside the city too.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: We swore to protect this city, and this home.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Zoya, what do you want to be when you grow up?

steps.name: Man
steps.text: You want to be like your papa? Haha, really? It's hard work.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Once you grow up, you'll understand all that Papa does. If that doesn't change your mind, then I'm looking forward to working with you, Zoya.
It's true. He did say it.
His mission in life was to protect. To protect me and Mom, to protect the family, to...
'To protect this city.'
Don't cry.
You can't cry.
I want to be like him. I want to...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Zoya.
...I'm fine. Don't worry.
Keep going.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: *Sigh...*

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: The point is, those awful Infected came out of nowhere, and there's too many of them.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Some of them seem to be restrained, but others are completely out of control, hellbent on razing the entire city.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: The Army has not come. But our comms are working fine. We have no idea what's going on with them.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: It's just us Guardsmen. There's not much we can do to stop them. But at least you'll be a little safer with us.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Oh, your father isn't with the squad now. He went over to Peterheim Middle School.
Peterheim...? Peterheim again...
What is he doing over there?

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Haven't you heard? The Infected locked up another group of kids in Peterheim, just like your school.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: It's weird. They don't seem to be doing anything to them. No movement out of there.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: But there's been some news in the last few days. Reunion seems to be pulling out. No matter what they're up to, we have to have a countermeasure in place.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: We can't spare much manpower. Only a few districts are calm, and others are so out of control that we could only send a small team to Peterheim.
Meaning, my dad?

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: He volunteered. Your father's experienced. I'm not worried.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: And since you're safe and sound, he'll rest easy too. A shame we don't have a way to contact him...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: We're short-handed everywhere. Damn it, what the hell's gotten into these Infected?!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Let's save the rest for later. We can't stay here any longer. There's no telling when the Army could show up... Where in hellfire is the Third Army when you need them?!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Anyway, Zoya, you take cover. Once the Army takes over, it'll be okay. This mob is no match for the soldiers of Ursus!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: And don't you worry. As soon as we free up some manpower, we'll send someone to Peterheim to rescue the students and pick up your father. Not to mention your school, all the schools.
If... if no one else is free, I can go.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: What?
I said, if you don't have any free hands, I can go get my dad!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Don't be stupid! That's way too dangerous! Absolutely not!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: You want to go alone? What help could you be?!
Uncle Valery!
I can tell we're in trouble here. And it looks like things are... they're getting worse, aren't they?
We don't have time to waste. The situation is getting more dangerous by the second. And if help isn't coming, you're only going to need more hands. So why not take mine?
I've watched how they operate at my school. I know how they patrol, I know how many men they put in a squad.
It's a different school, but their tactics should be pretty much the same...
I've been to Peterheim before. I know the campus layout. And I managed to dodge Reunion all the way here.
I can do this. I can help——

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: It's not the same!

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Listen to me. This isn't anything like what you've seen at the police station. It's not a drill. It's nothing like you think.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Zoya, I know you're strong, I know you're skilled. But you're still a kidl. Your life has value! This is not for you to do!
I know. It's making things worse for everyone, and I probably can't help much at all.
But, but I...
But what else can I do?
I'll...
I'm scared to think. I have to act.
Please. Let me go...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: *Sigh.*

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: It's not like you're going to listen to me anyway.
Sorry...

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Take this.
Hm?
What is it...?

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: It's supposed to connect to military comm networks. I'm not sure if it still works.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: If you're lucky, you can make contact with the Army once you reach Peterheim. If you can report the situation to them from there, that would be a big help.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: I know I can't stop you. Honestly, I have too much on my plate right now to worry about watching you. What you do now is entirely on you.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: But... Zoya, bear in mind, you are not a public servant. We are here to protect you.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Don't be a hero. Protecting yourself is your first priority.

steps.name: Valery
steps.text: Your father wouldn't want to see you in danger.
...Thank you.
Thank you, Uncle Valery.
I'll definitely...
Definitely what?
I don't finish the sentence.
Because we both know that promises like that are just desperate attempts at mutual comfort.
I make my way through the crowd, dodging the collapsing rubble and avoiding the vicious men ruining the city.
I think of nothing. I dare not think. I just push on towards my goal.
(Phew, I'm here.)
(Peterheim Middle School... The last time I was here, it was an academic exchange thing.)
(Looks like the Reunion guys are pretty much the same. Hourly intervals using one patrol team... shouldn't be tough to clear them.)
(Nothing to worry about. But why is it so quiet?)
(Huh? What's that over there...?)
What is it?
(What the hell are they?!)
(These... these are... students?)
What in the world?
(Or, I guess I should say, these... were... students.)
(There's scorch marks on the floor and walls. Everything is charred... But these kids, they didn't burn to death...)
Edged weapons, blunt weapons, and trampling?
(Ugh, how could this have happened? And why?)
(Did Reunion do this? But these wounds don't look like those thugs' handiwork.)
(And these students should be useful to them. Reunion wouldn't want to hurt kids, would they?)
Hm? What's that...?
Huh...?
There on the scorched ground, among the many school uniforms, one note slips out of the score, crashing heavily on the piano keys.
It's a scene I never imagined. Not even in my darkest nightmares.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Isn't it about time for the weather to turn? Hey, Zoya, what do you think of this outfit?

steps.name: Man
steps.text: Oh? Something I've been planning with your mom for a while now. *Sigh,* I'm always in uniform. It's so hard for me to find other things to wear.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: You want to go too? No can do. Absolutely not.

steps.name: Man
steps.text: It's a date for me and your mom.
Oh... oh...
Dad...?
Once the winter's over, when the weather turns, we'll have a little party, huh?
Drink some mead, cook some pancakes around the fire. We'll hold hands, sing, and dance in the muddy dirt. Even if the ground's still frozen, there'll be some little flowers blooming.
In this city, spring will come as usual.

steps.name: Logistics Worker
steps.text: Okay, formalities all taken care of.

steps.name: Logistics Worker
steps.text: Here's your registration card. You'll want to hold onto that.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (Great. All done.)

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (It's easy enough, once you get used to it.)

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: (I'm hungry... Might as well refill my meal card.)

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: That was super fun! The Doctor is so good at cards. Didn't lose a single hand! And then taught me how to 'poof' out a coin! Like this... 'poof!'

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hehe, that is a lot of fun indeed. Let's get Leto to join next time?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? No thanks...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: C'monnnn!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hey... Gummy. Inside voice.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hmph. Who cares if she doesn't wanna go? She's just scared she'll lose to me.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What? Who's gonna lose? You wanna bet?! Let's see who's scared of who!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Screw around and find out!

steps.name: Absinthe
steps.text: Those uniforms... They're——
They're from Peterheim...!
